deploy-bot: Build finished for tokenizer-service tag=release-2026-03-20 commit=abcdef1234 env=prod-region-1 — starting push to registry.redwoodinternal.io/repo/tokenizer-service

alex: saw a chunk error during push, CI log: `PUT /v2/repo/tokenizer-service/blobs/uploads/?upload_id=... 422 Unprocessable Entity`

alex: log shows `layer size mismatch (expected 10485760, got 10485696)` — weird off-by-24 bytes on a layer

samir: ugh, I've seen that with gzip metadata differences. Could be our local tar metadata ordering vs remote chunking. Try re-exporting with `docker save | gzip -n` to avoid mtime headers

deploy-bot: Retrying push (attempt 2) for digest computation sha256:temp-try...

deploy-bot: Push partially succeeded to mirror registry (mirror-registry.internal) but primary returned `422 checksum-mismatch` on layer 3

melissa: We're inside the scheduled change window but prod has active traffic. If we don't have a clean digest we should hold canary and pin to previous digest, not force an override.

sre-oncall: agree with @melissa. Don't risk forcing a digest override. If we can't get identical image bytes across registries, rollbacks will be painful.

alex: I can rebuild with deterministic gzip flags and retry. ETA ~8m. Would that unblock a clean push?

melissa: yes — rebuild + `gzip -n` and ensure layer ordering matches. Meanwhile we'll set canary = hold so traffic stays on current digest sha256:111aaa222bbb.

deploy-bot: Canary hold applied: route/canary/tokenizer-service -> pinned sha256:111aaa222bbb (protection flag enabled)

samir: started deterministic build: `bazel build //services/tokenizer:container && docker save ... | gzip -n`

deploy-bot: New push attempt (attempt 3) started against primary registry

deploy-bot: Push succeeded. Registry returned digest sha256:222ccc333ddd for tag release-2026-03-20 on primary. Mirror had sha256:222ccc333ddd as well.

melissa: thanks everyone. Plan: keep canary pinned for 30m, run smoke tests, then unpin and promote if green. If any regression, rollback to sha256:111aaa222bbb.

deploy-bot: Canary unpin scheduled at +30m unless `hold` reaction added. Smoke test job kicked: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/12345

alex: quick note — I pushed a short doc in the repo on deterministic layer builds to avoid future checksum drift. PR #412

samir: added a small regression test to verify gzip header invariance in our image pipeline

melissa: :thumbsup: leaving this thread open until canary window closes.
